paper_metadata.title: Stability of Superalloys Doped with Rare Earth Elements

evidence.quote: Economic considerations have led to growing interest in iron-based superalloys.

The stability of the microstructure and properties of the iron superalloys of the second generation IN 519 (24% Cr, 24% Ni, 1.5% Nb) modified with 0.1 and 0.2 [wt.%] rare earth elements was investigated.
